title: Find a compact TypeScript customer or identity corpus packet
description: Find and pin a compact complete TypeScript source scope with customer/account/identity data under a clearly usable license. Add scanner-blind proposed labels and a human review worksheet only; do not accept annotations without review.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Prepared the Medusa TypeScript packet: three complete non-enterprise model files (77 lines), pinned root license explicitly grants MIT for these paths, and 19 scanner-blind proposed records cover user/customer names, email, phone, metadata, avatar URL, attribution, and invitation-token ambiguity. Manifest tests pass; no label is accepted.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Proposed Medusa customer packet is on develop via PR #5 (tests/benchmark/repos/medusa-customer/). Closing this find-and-prepare sub-task. Acceptance remains DATAP-c66199.
